column1: # Pinned by the class's own member names: getWidth/getHeight -> width/height; the six synthetic
# accessors ScreenInputProcessor calls give the pointer state (frameCounter, touchDown +
# last two are what getTouchX/getTouchY return). The static caches are named by their getters:
# setApplication stores the GameApplication; getHudRenderer caches the GUI-atlas renderer per font
# suffix (b is that suffix); getMenuBackgroundRenderer/getTilesTexture/getUnitsTexture build the
# three shared resources from menu_background.png / texture_tiles.png / texture_units.png.
